Systolic Heart Failure SIM Revision no lasso

Larry Leon

Datasetup

t.start.all<-proc.time()[3]

data(peakVO2, package = "randomForestSRC")

dfa <- peakVO2

confounders.name <- names(dfa)
loc_remove <- which(confounders.name %in% c("died","ttodead","aspirin"))

confounders.name.start <- confounders.name[-c(loc_remove)]

cat("# of baseline confounders =",c(length(confounders.name.start)),"\n")
## # of baseline confounders = 38
dfa<-within(dfa,{
id<-as.numeric(c(1:nrow(dfa)))  
# time to months
time_months<-12*ttodead
treat <- 1-aspirin
event <- died
})


outcome.name<-c("time_months")
event.name<-c("event")
id.name<-c("id")
treat.name<-c("treat")
# Calculate Cox and RMST
itt_tab<-SGtab(df=dfa,SG_flag="ITT",outcome.name=outcome.name,event.name=event.name,treat.name=treat.name,draws=0)


plot_twosample(df=dfa,tte.name=outcome.name,treat.name=treat.name,event.name=event.name,
col.treat="blue",col.control="darkgrey",choose_ylim=TRUE,               
ylab="Survival Probability", xlab="Months", show.Y.axis=TRUE,               
byrisk=6,show.med=FALSE,legend.cex=0.5,risk.cex=0.5,censor.cex=0.7,cox.cex=0.55,cex_Yaxis=0.65)

# For draws>0 (above) will calculate simultaneous band
#plotband_survdiff(res=itt_tab$rmst_fit)
print(itt_tab$res_out)
##      Subgroup n      n1     n0     m1     m0     RMST_uadj(CI)        
## [1,] "ITT"    "2231" "1193" "1038" "81.2" "85.2" "-3.92 (-7.29,-0.55)"
##      HR_uadj(CI)     HR*(CI)
## [1,] "1.16 (1,1.35)" NA
# Add 20 noise baseline variables
set.seed(8316951)

N <-nrow(dfa)

Knoise <- 100

df.noise <- data.frame(replicate(Knoise,rnorm(n=N)))

noise.name <- paste0("noise",1:Knoise)

names(df.noise) <- noise.name

df.analysis <- cbind(dfa, df.noise)

confounders.name <- c(confounders.name.start,noise.name)


t.start.fs<-proc.time()[3]

use_lasso <- TRUE
use_grf <- FALSE

# Nsg_only
sg_focus <- "Nsg_only"

hr.threshold<-1/0.6   # Initital candidates 
hr.consistency<-1/.80  # Candidates for many splits
pconsistency.threshold <- 0.90
stop.threshold <- 0.90

max.minutes <- 10.0

fs.est <- forestsearch(df.analysis=df.analysis, Allconfounders.name=confounders.name,
outcome.name=outcome.name,treat.name=treat.name,
event.name=event.name,id.name=id.name,
hr.threshold=hr.threshold,hr.consistency=hr.consistency,stop.threshold=stop.threshold,
pconsistency.threshold=pconsistency.threshold, 
pstop_futile=0.50,
conf_force=NULL,
details=TRUE,
use_lasso=use_lasso, 
use_grf=use_grf,
max.minutes=max.minutes,
defaultcut_names=NULL,
cut_type="default",
dmin.grf=4, frac.tau=0.60, grf_depth=2,
maxk=2,
sg_focus=sg_focus,
n.min=60,
fs.splits=1000,
d0.min=10,d1.min=10,
by.risk=12,
plot.sg=TRUE)
